chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn narrated from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Amr ibn Shimir from Jabir who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'When I attend the funeral prayer at the time of a prescribed prayer, which of the two do I begin with?' He said, 'Hurry the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time for the obligatory prayer will pass, and do not delay the funeral prayer until the rising of the sun or its setting.'
ai.seo_question: Which takes precedence: funeral prayer or obligatory prayer when they coincide?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies the hierarchy between Salat al-Janazah and Salat al-Faridah, establishing that hastening the burial is preferred unless it risks missing the obligatory prayer's time window. This ruling reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle of balancing the communal duty of honoring the deceased with the individual's primary obligation to worship, while also noting the specific prohibition against delaying prayers during the times of sun rise (Ishraq) and sun set (Ghurub).
